napuli.munaciello.steal: O Munaciello stole your %s! Catch him!
napuli.raggia.2: O Munaciello is really angry now. Careful.
napuli.raggia.max: You made O Munaciello furious. Tonight, do not look around.
napuli.vigile.multa: VIGILE: Uè! Addò sta 'o casco?! Multa: n'ismeraldo.
napuli.vigile.perdono: VIGILE: Uè, senza casco?! Va buò, pe' stavota... ma nun te fà vedé cchiù!
napuli.casco.risate: 'E paesane te guardano e ridono: «Ma chi è chisto c' 'o casco 'ncapa?!»
napuli.mamma.title: MAMMÀ
napuli.mamma.chiama: Guagliò, è pronto a tavola! Tuorne a casa!
napuli.mamma.chat: MAMMÀ: GUAGLIÒÒÒ! È PRONTO! Si nun tuorne mo' mo', vide che te succede...
napuli.mamma.brava: MAMMÀ: Bravo guaglione mio! Tiene, t'aggio fatto 'a pizza.
napuli.ciabatta.title: 'A CIABATTA!
napuli.paesano.botte: PAESANO: Uè uè uè! Ma che faje?! Mo' chiammo a mammà toja!
napuli.paesano.1: PAESANO: Accattate quaccosa, nun fà 'o sparagnino!
napuli.paesano.2: PAESANO: Mo' te faccio nu prezzo buono... sulo pe' te.
napuli.paesano.4: PAESANO: Hai visto 'o Munaciello? Statte accorto.
napuli.paesano.5: PAESANO: Ma tu 'e chi si' figlio?
napuli.paesano.6: PAESANO: Jamme, ca 'a vita è na sola!
napuli.paesano.7: PAESANO: Uè, 'o motorino tujo è bello assaje. Quanto vuò?
napuli.city.unavailable: Naples could not load in this world.
napuli.city.guide: Welcome to Naples! /napoli luoghi opens the district atlas and walking directions. /napoli esci to return.
napuli.dialog.teresa.hello: Hey, how's it going? You're welcome to sit here.
napuli.dialog.teresa.flirt: When I see you walk in, I can't help smiling.
napuli.dialog.teresa.together: I saved you a seat. So, what's new?
napuli.dialog.teresa.approach: Teresa: %s, come here! I was just thinking about you.
napuli.dialog.teresa.invite: Want to get a coffee tonight, just the two of us?
napuli.dialog.lucia.hello: Hey! Can you hear everyone's footsteps echoing under the dome?
napuli.dialog.lucia.flirt: Even the quiet is nice with you. Stay a little longer.
napuli.dialog.lucia.together: I was waiting for you. Shall we take a walk later?
napuli.dialog.lucia.approach: Lucia: %s, want to watch the sky together?
napuli.dialog.lucia.invite: I want to show you the sea at sunset. Would you come with me?
napuli.dialog.choice.compliment: I like spending time with you
napuli.dialog.choice.coffee: Can I buy you a coffee?
napuli.dialog.reply.listen_teresa: I'm always at the café. After work I go listen to live music.
napuli.dialog.reply.listen_lucia: I sketch the gallery when it rains. The floor reflects everything.
napuli.dialog.reply.joke_teresa: That's a good one! Hang on, I've got one for you.
napuli.dialog.reply.joke_lucia: I have to admit it. You made me laugh.
napuli.dialog.reply.compliment: I like spending time with you too. There, I said it.
napuli.dialog.reply.slow: Let's take it slow. I'd like to get to know you first.
napuli.dialog.reply.coffee: Yes, please. Next one's on me.
napuli.dialog.reply.walk: Let's head towards the sea. You can feel the breeze down there.
napuli.dialog.reply.accept: It's a date, then. I'm looking forward to it.
napuli.dialog.reply.decline: %s: That's fine. We can take our time.
napuli.dialog.reply.repeat: We already talked about that today. Tell me something else.
napuli.meme.motorino: Enzo: “Why not Naples?” Gennaro: “Where do you think we are? All three aboard!”
napuli.meme.motorino.gennaro: Where do you think we are? All three aboard!
napuli.folklore.mbriana: “Good evening.” Bella 'Mbriana pauses under the dome and the chill fades.
napuli.folklore.partenope: A voice drifts in from the sea. Partenope is calling you.
napuli.folklore.anima: A wandering soul sighs among the bones. The lanterns grow dim.
napuli.folklore.charm: The cornicello warms in your hand. The curse fades.
napuli.street.vendor: Pizza, bread, and coffee. I also have a delivery for the harbor.
napuli.street.tailor: I sell clothes and equipment for defense.
napuli.street.busker: Three cups, one ball. Two coins to play. The house has the edge: one chance in five.
napuli.street.hello: Hey, around here the uphill walk is the elevator!
napuli.street.route: Deliver to Concetta on the waterfront (13, 64, 52) within 4 minutes for 12 coins.
napuli.street.cups_win: You found it! Four coins profit.
napuli.street.cups_lose: The ball vanished. You lost two coins.
napuli.street.theft: Hold on to your things: the Munaciello is here.
napuli.street.full: You've eaten a lot and feel heavier. It wears off over time.
napuli.street.clash: At the harbor Nico of the Lanterns is fighting Antonio of the Tides!
napuli.street.meme_ritardo: Sorry I'm late! The scooter was full.
napuli.street.ada: I'm Ada of the Lanterns of the Spanish Quarter. Will you help?
napuli.street.michele: Did Ada send anything for our workshop?
napuli.street.salvatore: I'm Salvatore of the Tides of Borgo Marinari. We need a hand.
napuli.street.rosa: The harbor is waiting for supplies. Did Salvatore send you?
napuli.street.help_clash: Help this crew in the clash

napuli.cc.title: CARABINIERI!
napuli.cc.seen.pizzo: They saw you collecting the pizzo. Run!
napuli.cc.seen.homicide: A homicide was reported. The carabinieri are looking for you.

napuli.cc.called: An old lady at the window called 112...
napuli.cc.worse: Now it's worse: they want to lock you up!

napuli.cc.fine.title: FINE

napuli.cc.free.title: FREE
napuli.cc.talk.wanted: CARABINIERE: Stop right there! Hands where I can see them!
napuli.cc.talk.2: CARABINIERE: The match is on tonight. No trouble.
napuli.cc.talk.3: CARABINIERE: Helmet on the scooter, please.
napuli.dialog.carmela.hello: Uè! Trase, 'o furno è caldo. Na margherita?
napuli.dialog.carmela.flirt: Pe' te 'a pizza 'a faccio a forma 'e core.
napuli.dialog.carmela.together: T'aggio stipato 'a fetta cchiù bella. Assiettate.
napuli.dialog.carmela.approach: Carmela: %s! È asciuta 'a pizza fritta, curre!
napuli.dialog.carmela.invite: Dimane chiudo 'a pizzeria. Ce ne jammo a Mergellina, io e te?
napuli.dialog.reply.listen_carmela: 'A pizzeria era 'e nonno. 'O furno l'ha fatto isso, pret' 'e Vesuvio.
napuli.dialog.reply.joke_carmela: Ahah! Statte zitto, ca me faje abbrucià 'a margherita!
napuli.dialog.giusy.hello: Uè, bello! Hai sentuto l'urdema canzona mia? È nu successo!
napuli.dialog.giusy.flirt: Si me guarde accussì, te dedico 'o prossimo pezzo.
napuli.dialog.giusy.invite: Vieni cu mme a 'o matrimonio addò canto sabato? Te faccio ballà.
napuli.dialog.reply.listen_giusy: Canto a 'e matrimoni e 'e comunioni. Nu juorno me sentono a Sanremo, vide.
napuli.dialog.reply.joke_giusy: AHAHAH! Si cchiù scemo 'e me! Mi piaci, mi piaci assaje.
napuli.dialog.sofia.hello: Ciao... scusa, sto studiando. Federico II, esame 'e storia 'e Napule.
napuli.dialog.sofia.flirt: Sai che cu tte me scordo pure 'e date 'e Masaniello?
napuli.dialog.sofia.together: Aggio pigliato 30! Te l'aggio vuluto dicere a te pe' primmo.
napuli.dialog.sofia.invite: Ce sta na mostra 'a Galleria stasera. Ce vulisse venì cu mme?
napuli.dialog.reply.listen_sofia: Napule è sotto 'e piere nuoste: grotte, cisterne, strade antiche. Me fa impazzì.
napuli.dialog.reply.joke_sofia: Ahah, carina... ma nun me distraì, ca tengo l'esame!
napuli.casco.alt: 🚨 CARABINIERE: «Stop! Three on a scooter and not one helmet?! Pull over!»
napuli.casco.carcere: 🚔 CARABINIERE: «No helmet and three of you... All %s of you to the station! The scooter is seized.»

napuli.people.nonna.0: Oh, how handsome! You look like my grandson.
napuli.people.nonna.1: Watch out for the scooters, they drive like madmen.
napuli.people.nonna.2: In my day things were different… even the tomatoes.
napuli.people.nonna.3: Have you eaten? Doesn't look like it.
napuli.people.nonna.gift: Eat, you're too thin! Here, a pizza. Don't tell your mother.
napuli.people.parcheggiatore.0: Doctor, if you have a car, I'll watch it for you.
napuli.people.parcheggiatore.1: You park here only with my permission.
napuli.people.parcheggiatore.2: The City Council? Here, I'm the City Council.
napuli.people.parcheggiatore.3: Reverse, I'll tell you when, go go… stop!
napuli.people.parcheggiatore.paid: Thanks doctor, 2 euro. Your scooter is in good hands… mine.
napuli.people.parcheggiatore.broke: No 2 euro, no watching the scooter. No guarantees either.
napuli.people.tifoso.1: Ten is a sacred number, you know?
napuli.people.tifoso.2: We'll celebrate this title all over again!
napuli.people.tifoso.3: Un giorno all'improvviso… m'innamorai di te!
napuli.people.scugnizzo.1: I know every shortcut in the Quarter.
napuli.people.scugnizzo.2: When I grow up I'll be a footballer. Or a parking guy.
napuli.people.scugnizzo.3: I didn't do anything, I swear!
napuli.people.scugnizzo.pinch: *slips a euro out of your pocket and runs off laughing*
napuli.people.presepaio.0: A nativity is like life: there's always a shepherdess missing.
napuli.people.presepaio.1: This figurine is Maradona, that one Pulcinella.
napuli.people.presepaio.2: San Gregorio Armeno: Christmas all year round.
napuli.people.presepaio.3: A cornicello? Never skimp against bad luck.
napuli.people.presepaio.sold: Here, a red cornicello. Always keep it on you.
napuli.people.pizzaiolo.0: Pizza is serious business: flour, water, salt, yeast and love.
napuli.people.pizzaiolo.2: The wood oven never goes out.
napuli.people.pizzaiolo.3: Margherita, like the queen. Basil, mozzarella and tomato.
napuli.people.pizzaiolo.sold: Here you go, a steaming margherita. Careful, it's hot!

napuli.horror.bargain: I saw your cornicello. I'm giving back your %s.
napuli.horror.stalk: Hear those footsteps? Something is following you.
napuli.horror.dropped: The Munaciello dropped %s. Look where the trail ends.
napuli.horror.giant_windup: The Giant saw you. Run toward a light!
napuli.horror.giant_lost: The Giant lost sight of you.
napuli.horror.crypt_warning: The light in the crypt went out. Did you hear that sigh?
napuli.horror.answer_anima: The spirit rests. Your fear fades.
napuli.local.return: Objective reached. Go back and report.
napuli.local.wrong_direction: The tourist shakes their head. They want an arcade with a glass dome.
napuli.local.beat_retry: Start again at the first note.
napuli.local.pizzaiolo.intro: The oven is ready. Want to learn the recipe or help me out?
napuli.local.pizzaiolo.lesson: Check your recipe book for two recipes. Bread, two beetroots and milk make two pizzas. Bread, beetroot and wheat seeds make one marinara.
napuli.local.pizzaiolo.task: Bring me two pizzas for the evening shift.
napuli.local.bucato.intro: You can see the whole neighborhood from up there. I can take you up.
napuli.local.bucato.lesson: Follow the laundry to the carved stone at the far end of the terrace. Then come back to me.
napuli.local.bucato.task: Find the carved stone at the end of the terrace.
napuli.local.turista.intro: I’m lost. Where’s that covered arcade with the glass dome?
napuli.local.turista.lesson: Galleria Umberto I is opposite the San Carlo Theatre.
napuli.local.turista.task: Point me to the arcade with the glass dome.
napuli.local.pescatore.intro: I have a spare rod. Let me show you the basics.
napuli.local.pescatore.lesson: Cast into the Gulf. When the bobber goes under with a splash, reel it in immediately.
napuli.local.pescatore.task: Catch and bring me three raw cod.
napuli.local.custode_tunnel.intro: An old aqueduct runs below us. I can take you to the entrance.
napuli.local.custode_tunnel.lesson: Cross the tuff gallery and follow the pale path between the pools. Look down the side tunnel too.
napuli.local.custode_tunnel.task: Reach the carved stone at the far end of the cistern and report back.
napuli.local.cartomante.intro: One card shows still water. Another shows violet stone beneath the city.
napuli.local.cartomante.lesson: The Moon points to the aqueduct’s side tunnel. Look for amethyst crystals.
napuli.local.cartomante.task: Bring me one amethyst shard to finish the reading.
napuli.local.mercatante.intro: Bread, milk, vegetables and fish. What can I get you?
napuli.local.mercatante.lesson: The pizza maker uses beetroot and milk. The nativity keeper needs candles.
napuli.local.musicista.intro: Try to repeat the notes from my mandolin.
napuli.local.musicista.lesson: Listen first, then play it using the three buttons. A wrong note sends you back to the beginning.
napuli.local.musicista.task: Play all four notes in order.
napuli.local.guardiano_presepe.intro: The nativity scene of San Gregorio Armeno needs lights for Christmas.
napuli.local.guardiano_presepe.lesson: Buy or craft candles and bring them over. We’ll put them among the workshops.
napuli.local.guardiano_presepe.task: Bring me three candles for the nativity scene.

napuli.ui.phone.service.taxi_arrived: Taxi arrived near %s. Enjoy your walk!
napuli.ui.phone.service.cancelled: Service cancelled. A taxi trip already started remains paid.

napuli.cc.seen.trespass: You were seen using a bed without permission!

napuli.ui.hub.welcome: Everything you need for life in the city.
napuli.ui.hub.section.featured: Where would you like to start?
